_comment: Small text cuts applied to the build copy of frontend/ (never to frontend/ itself).
Each cut must match exactly `count` times (default 1) or the build fails,
so an app change can never silently bring a removed control back.

cuts.why: hide layer switches the viewer does not offer
remove the Meshtastic 'scan planet' button (starts a scan on the owner's server)
remove the OSM basemap (its tiles come through the owner's tile proxy)
place-name search is off in the viewer; say so plainly
cuts.find: Place search unavailable — check backend connection
cuts.replace: Place names are off in the public viewer. Enter coordinates, e.g. 48.85, 2.35

cuts.why: hide the AI Intelligence Brief button (runs the owner's AI on demand)
hide the MKT switch (turns market fetching on for the whole server)
cuts.replace:
hidden
                                    title={
                                        marketsCorrelationEnabled
                                            ? 'Prediction market correlation on intercept stories (clearnet Polymarket/Kalshi)'
